fact: On 13 March 2025 Cote d'Ivoire launched the Electronic Administration Support Project (PARAE), rooted in the National Digital Development Strategy (2021-2025), with a 49 billion FCFA African Development Bank investment, and unveiled national AI and data governance strategies.
title: Côte d'Ivoire Leaps Forward with New Digital Initiatives to Revolutionize Public Administration and Service Delivery
